nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer (transferOwnership / acceptOwnership).
Public token symbol string, set to "pHIX" in the PreHELIX constructor.
Public token name string, set to "PreHELIX Token" in the constructor.
Public token decimals value, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply, minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
Mapping of holder address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): returns a+b with an overflow check require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): returns a-b guarded by require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): returns a*b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): returns a/b guarded by require(b > 0).
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender during deployment.
onlyOwner function that sets the pending newOwner address.
Completes ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner, then rotates owner.
PreHELIX constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints total supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] as the circulating supply.
Returns the token balance of the supplied tokenOwner.
ERC20 transfer: debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[to] using SafeMath.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no double-spend protection, then emits Approval.
Spends allowance: debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits balances[to].
Returns the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Sets allowance then invokes an arbitrary spender contract receiveApproval (external call).
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts; contract must not accept ETH.
onlyOwner rescue function that calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 tokenAddress to the owner.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances and ownership checks.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an attacker-controlled contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary, caller-supplied token contract.

edges.reason: Owned constructor receives msg.sender and assigns it as the owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on require(msg.sender == owner).
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before rotating ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using caller-controlled address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] with the caller address.
approveAndCall grants allowance from msg.sender and then performs an external call.
Deployment caller triggers the constructor which mints supply and emits Transfer.
Owned constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership stores the pending address in newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
Constructor initializes symbol.
Constructor initializes name.
Constructor initializes decimals.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed initial supply.
Constructor credits the entire supply to a fixed deployer address in balances.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply when computing circulating supply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom debits and credits the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed nested allowance mapping.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external invocation.
transferAnyERC20Token directs rescued tokens to the owner address.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance safely.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance safely.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance subtraction.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
approveAndCall transfers control to an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval.
The external receiveApproval call executes after allowance state is written, allowing re-entrant allowance manipulation.
A malicious spender contract can call back into the token during the receiveApproval external call.
onlyOwner rescue path performs an external call to an arbitrary ERC20 contract.
The external ERC20 transfer sends tokens to the privileged owner address.
The spender parameter is used directly as the target of the external receiveApproval call.
